# Queen Amberwing

*The great hive of the Selsior Downs has a queen larger than a calf, walled in old comb in a hollow of the chalk. Watch her dive; when the comb drips, keep moving. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [Queen Amberwing](../monsters/queen_amberwing.md) |
| Arena | [The Hive Hollow](../maps/hive_hollow.md) |

- Unlocked by [The Great Hive](../quests/godwin_the_great_hive.md)
- Entered by talking to [Edric](../npcs/edric.md)
